svg.text: Hardware Nodes, Local Network Topology, Flask Execution Environment, and Mobile Notification Service

g.text: • 10 kΩ Voltage Divider connected to 3.3V & GND
• Triggers after 30 seconds of sustained pressure
• Driven by ESP32 Pin: GPIO 25 (Digital Output)
• Alert Dispatcher: Generates High Pressure & High Risk Events
• Profile Management: Patient, Caregiver, and Admin Roles
• Local relational database file on MacBook disk
• Table `events`: (id, device_id, event_type, peak_fsr, peak_temp, time)
• Custom SVG history charts rendered in pure JavaScript
• Visual Alert Banner & Audio Alarm Tone Player
• Live Pressure & Temp Display / 30s Horizontal Timer Bar
• High Pressure & High Risk Visual Alerts
• Alerts patient on sustained pressure via Internet
• Immediate alerts for HIGH PRESSURE / HIGH RISK
• Apple Push Notification Service (APNs) & Firebase Cloud Messaging (FCM)
• Triggered asynchronously when Flask detects 30s sustained high pressure
• Delivers notifications to Patient Mobile Profile and Caregiver Profile
Flow: Flask Alert Service ──► Mobile Notification Service ──► Patient / Caregiver Device
Requirement: Requires Internet Connectivity (External WAN Uplink)
LOCAL AIR-GAPPED MONITORING (STEP-SAFE Wi-Fi — No Internet Required):
ESP32 hosts local SoftAP ("STEP-SAFE" @ 192.168.4.1). MacBook connects to AP (192.168.4.2) to run Flask & SQLite. Local piezo buzzer alarms on GPIO 25.
Patient and Caregiver connect directly to local Wi-Fi to access live responsive web dashboard and custom SVG charts without internet access.
MOBILE NOTIFICATION SERVICE (Firebase / APNs Push — Internet Required):
Cloud push notifications (APNs / FCM) require internet connectivity on the MacBook and mobile devices to dispatch out-of-band alerts.
